_comment: Predefined fixed clip set (PI request, 2026-08-02): the same clips are shown to every participant -- only presentation order is randomized per participant (see emotion_task.clip_selection_mode: fixed in session_config.yaml). 2026-08-11: positive/negative groups REPLACED entirely with a participant-supplied set of 3 clips each (clip_82-84 / clip_85-87, see app/config/emotion_manifest.json's fine_grained_label filmstim_positive/filmstim_negative) -- these are NOT from OpenLAV, so there's no arousal_score/valence_score to rank them by (left null). emotion_task.clips_per_group was dropped to {positive: 3, negative: 3, neutral: 4} to match (only 3 clips exist per group now, vs. the 4 previously selected from OpenLAV's larger pool). Neutral group is untouched -- still the OpenLAV picks from the arousal-ranking history below. OLD HISTORY (positive/negative, no longer in effect): originally ranked by HIGHEST arousal_score (video_data.csv 'arousal_wsd' column, used as a proxy for strong emotion induction -- NOT the raw 'arousal' column, which mixes inconsistent units across rows); neutral group ranked by LOWEST arousal_score (calmest). 2026-08-05: trimmed 10/group -> 6/group (per PI timing-budget discussion -- emotion_task.clips_per_group) by keeping the 6 SHORTEST-duration clips (see app/config/emotion_manifest.json's duration_sec) from each of the original 10, to fit the 20-min controlled-time target; relative order within each group is otherwise unchanged from the original arousal-based selection. 2026-08-06: discovered arousal_wsd ALSO has the same mixed-unit defect the raw 'arousal' column has, just rarer (~11% of video_data.csv rows) -- 3 of the 6 positive-group picks from the 2026-08-05 duration trim (VID_502/517/512) landed on this broken near-zero cluster (0.28-0.33) instead of a real arousal value, so their 'strong emotion' ranking was never meaningful. Swapped those 3 for the next-highest-arousal clips that (a) have a real arousal_wsd, (b) were already in the participant's own 2026-08-04 hand-picked candidate list (scripts/emotion_clip_picks_2026-08-04.txt) so no new quality/duration vetting is needed, and (c) are already downloaded and wired into emotion_manifest.json: VID_721 (478), VID_712 (423), VID_524 (314). VID_906 (365) was deliberately skipped despite qualifying, per explicit request. Net effect: positive-group total duration 271s -> 283s (+12s), negligible against the ~23.7 min session budget. Negative/neutral groups unchanged (no anomalous arousal_wsd values in their current picks). Regenerate the original 10/group set with scripts/select_fixed_emotion_clips.py [--n-per-group N] if starting over (note: that script does not know about the arousal_wsd anomaly and would need a manual re-check afterward).
